title: Give an interrupted managed custody journal publication (partial managed.pending) a supported recovery route and an accurate refusal
outcome: Give an interrupted managed custody journal publication (partial managed.pending) a supported recovery route and an accurate refusal
acceptance: after a writer dies between creating managed.pending and completing it, a named recovery step under the held repository reservation discards the unparseable pending file and records that it did, so exports, imports and managed_audit proceed; a well-formed divergent pending is still refused; the refusal text names that step; with a test
